title: Temporal Types
description: Timestamp and temporal type definitions for agentics-org-manifests

ObservedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the data was observed in the source system

CreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the manifest was created

ExtractedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when data was extracted from source

EffectiveDate.description: ISO 8601 date when a policy or rule becomes effective

ExpirationDate.description: ISO 8601 date when a certification or policy expires

FiscalYearEnd.description: Fiscal year end date in MM-DD format

TemporalRange.description: Temporal range with required start and optional end
